programs.description: Veerabhadran is a chieftain of a tribal group who goes to any extent to help his people. However, he soon realises that the enemy is within his tribe.
Puzhayozhukum Vazhi
Four troublemaking friends constantly annoy their landlord in a rented house. Forced to leave, they escape to Pondicherry, where new adventures await.
A young man suffering from a hearing defect rises up against a corrupt local leader along with the help of his fearless older brother. Together, they defy tyranny in a fight for justice and freedom.
A musically gifted man pretending to be a priest wins hearts in a royal household, but buried family secrets and a long-lost connection soon stir tension beneath the festivities.
After a lottery ticket salesman learns that one of his customers has won INR five crores, he tries to get back the ticket. Unfortunately, he finds the customer dead and has to lie to protect himself.
In the 1960s, when interreligious marriages were still taboo, Moideen and Kanchanamala fell in love. Even after being forced to part ways, the two lovers fight for their undying love.
While George's first love disappoints him, Malar, a college lecturer, restores his faith in love. His romantic journey takes him through several stages and helps him find his purpose.
After a past incident, two powerful clans of Krishnapuram remain estranged until one day, a man with a mysterious past decides to bring the families together.
After a past incident, two powerful clans of Krishnapuram remain estranged until one day, a man with a mysterious past decides to bring the families together.
Roby, a young man, migrates to Las Vegas in hopes of earning a livelihood and starts working at a casino. Things take a turn when he loses his friend's money and struggles with mental health issues.
Susanna, a sex worker, earns money by being with five different men at the same time. Fortunately, the people around her do not judge her actions and find solace in her presence.
Fed up with the fast-paced city life, Ramdas and his wife decide to move to a quiet bungalow on the outskirts of the city. However, some strange happenings in the surrounding put their lives at risk.
When Unnimol, a young girl child, faces dismissal from all her relatives and community, Lord Ayyappan takes the form of a school student to help her overcome obstacles.
Prakash, a successful businessman, grows suspicious of his wife Anita after he receives an anonymous letter that indicates that she has an illicit relationship with another man.
A car that Mahadevan wins in a contest brings him bad luck, and he soon gets involved in a murder. As he tries to find a car with the same license number as his, he unravels a shocking truth.
Babu perfects the art of being a clown and is promised the hand of Kamala, the circus owner's daughter. However, things take a turn when Sudheer Misra arrives in the troupe.

A young woman faces constant torment and oppression from her family, but remains resilient in her search for love and happiness.
A father's decision to remarry brings unexpected struggles as his son Sethumadhavan steps up to care for his half-sisters, navigating shifting family relationships.
Sridevi leads a peaceful and happy life with her husband, Balakrishnan, and his siblings. However, the family faces various adversities that challenge their bonding.
Mahesh loves his daughter but does not know how to relay his affection for her, while Ishita showers her with love, which drives him to envy. It is up to her to bring them closer to each other.
When the past of a middle-aged unmarried businessman confronts him, it affects his unusual romantic relationship with a younger girl.
Kalyani, who is speech impaired, is disliked by everyone in her family, except her mother. As she longs for her father's affection, Kiran enters her life.
When Major Mahadevan receives news of terrorists hiding inside a mosque, he and his team set out to apprehend them and then he takes help of his team member, Jai, and plans to execute the mission.

Unni, who has a feminine voice, gets insulted by everyone in his neighbourhood. His life takes a turn when he gets married to a rich girl who is speech-impaired.
Ravi Varman, a psychiatrist, treats only one patient at a time and that too in isolation. When he learns that his former patient Yamuna is getting married, he decides to meet her.
